goal: SOTA BPC for autoregressive char-level text generation on enwik8 (target <= 1.05 BPC) and text8 (target <= 1.05 BPC).

current_best.time_to_convergence: ~58.7 min (3524s) to 1.8833 BPC @ E40 at locked 30M/512/40ep budget
current_best.notes: Iter-15 (kernel v23) = window-warmup run. New best 1.8833 BPC. Iter-16 (v24, bigram-hash embedding rec 62) REGRESSED to 1.9049 BPC (hzyupupg, hopeful-tree-15, 3507s) — bigram disabled again in v25. Locked budget 30M chars / block 512 / 40ep / bs96 is the minimal converging budget found so far (~59 min). Progression: 3.493 -> 3.268 -> 3.011 -> 2.5909 -> 2.3023 -> 2.2878 (d1024/40ep, bs256) -> 2.2597 (bs512@10M) -> 1.8869 (30M chars, bs512) -> 1.8833 (window-warmup) -> [1.9049 bigram regression].

historical_source.note: Provenance kept for the agent's startup context. Identifiers (kernel slug, W&B entity/project/sweep/run) are NOT committed publicly — they are supplied to the runtime via GitHub Actions env vars / repository variables (WANDB_ENTITY, WANDB_PROJECT, WANDB_SWEEP_ID) and Kaggle secrets. Treat these fields as opaque labels when reading this file in the public mirror.

sota_reference.note: SOTA targets here are ballpark recent transformer-class results; the canonical target is improving on the user's own current best BPC, then chasing published SOTA.

next_iteration_directions: Iter-17 (in flight): revert bigram-hash (it regressed 1.8833->1.9049 in iter-16) and add QK-norm (LayerNorm on Q/K, modded-nanogpt rec 5) to the chunk-level attention — the chunk decoder now runs 128 chunk positions at block 512, and QK-norm stabilizes attention logits at longer context. Budget locked at 30M/512/40ep. Target <1.88 BPC.
If QK-norm helps, apply it to the token-level decoder too, or sweep the window-warmup shape (start=16 vs 32, warmup epochs 8/12/16).
Re-enable the online W&B sweep over d_model/chunk_dec_layers/lr once QK-norm is green.
Add ModelCheckpoint every epoch + resume-on-restart so a TPU session timeout never loses progress.
Evaluate ALiBi for chunk-level attention (currently forced off in TF due to slow impl).
Add a true text8 evaluation path (alternative corpus to cross-validate generalization).
